events.title: ANTI-ANTI Hits 1,000 Steam Wishlists!
events.summary: STEAM WISHLIST 1,000+ANTI-ANTI Hits 1,000 Wishlists!Thanks to your interest and support, ANTI-ANTI has reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam!A heartfelt thank you to everyone who discovered the game and added it to their wishlist.Official Release: October 27!I can't wait to share the full story with you. Thank you!

events.title: New Emojis Added to Our Official Discord!
events.summary: You can now use exclusive emojis in the official Discord server for Anti-anti!We'll continue adding more emojis in the future.Our Discord community is still small, so we'd love for you to join us! https://discord.gg/z6xx35nrTm

events.title: ANTI-ANTI – Steam Next Fest Participation & Full Release Announcement
events.summary: ANTI-ANTI will be participating in Steam Next Fest, running from October 19 to 26!After Steam Next Fest ends, the demo will no longer be available for download on Steam, with the full game launching on October 27!We hope you'll look forward to the release!

events.title: Official Discord Server Announcement
events.summary: Hello, players! has an official Discord server!https://discord.gg/z6xx35nrTmAs is currently in the demo release stage, minor update announcements are posted exclusively on Discord.The server includes channels for update announcements, bug reports, general discussions, and spoiler discussions covering content up to the end of the demo.Please note that the server is primarily operated in Korean, so users who speak other languages may experience some inconvenience.Thank you for your understanding.

events.title: Demo Coming October 1 & Full Release Date Announced
events.summary: 📢 Release Schedule Demo Release October 1, 2026 — 10:00 PM KST / 6:00 AM PDT Full Release October 27, 2026 — 5:00 PM KST / 1:00 AM PDT 🎮 Demo Release Just one week to go! The demo is coming! The demo will be released on October 1 at 6:00 AM PDT! The demo includes approximately 1–2 hours of content from the beginning of the game. Your achievements and progress from the demo will carry over to the full version. ✨ Full Release The full version of will be released on October 27 at 1:00 AM PDT.
